scenarios.name: routed-with-0013
scenarios.schemaDescription: full TypeScript migrations 0001-0020 (task_id 0011 and owner_user_id 0013 present) plus graphile-worker

sql.text: SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '30s'
SET statement_timeout = '60s'
BEGIN
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext($1))
SELECT id, title FROM ros_conversations WHERE session_key = $1 AND agent = $2

SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM pg_attribute
      WHERE attname = 'owner_user_id' AND NOT attisdropped
        AND attrelid IN (to_regclass('ros_conversations'), to_regclass('ros_messages'))

INSERT INTO ros_conversations
       (session_key, agent, channel, title, settings, active, created_at, updated_at
        , owner_user_id)
     VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,COALESCE($7,now()),COALESCE($8,now())
        , $9)
     RETURNING id

INSERT INTO ros_messages
       (conversation_id, agent, channel, role, content, tool_name, tool_args, tool_result, metadata, created_at, owner_user_id)
     VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,COALESCE($10,now()), $11)
UPDATE ros_conversations SET updated_at = now(), settings = $2 WHERE id = $1
COMMIT
SET idle_in_transaction_session_timeout = '30s'
SET statement_timeout = '60s'
BEGIN
SELECT pg_advisory_xact_lock(hashtext($1))
SELECT id, title FROM ros_conversations WHERE session_key = $1 AND agent = $2

SELECT count(*)::int AS n FROM pg_attribute
      WHERE attname = 'owner_user_id' AND NOT attisdropped
        AND attrelid IN (to_regclass('ros_conversations'), to_regclass('ros_messages'))
UPDATE ros_conversations SET owner_user_id = $2 WHERE id = $1 AND owner_user_id IS NULL

SELECT metadata->>'uuid' AS uuid FROM ros_messages
        WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND role = 'assistant' AND metadata ? 'uuid'

INSERT INTO ros_messages
       (conversation_id, agent, channel, role, content, tool_name, tool_args, tool_result, metadata, created_at, owner_user_id)
     VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,COALESCE($10,now()), $11)

SELECT tool_name, tool_args::text AS args FROM ros_messages
        WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND role = 'tool'

INSERT INTO ros_messages
       (conversation_id, agent, channel, role, content, tool_name, tool_args, tool_result, metadata, created_at, owner_user_id)
     VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8,$9,COALESCE($10,now()), $11)
SELECT content FROM ros_messages WHERE conversation_id = $1 AND role = 'user'

UPDATE ros_conversations
         SET updated_at = COALESCE($2, now()),
             active = $3,
             title = COALESCE($4, title),
             settings = $5
       WHERE id = $1
COMMIT
